decisions.name: Use asynchronous event-based messaging for communication between services
decisions.rationale: To ensure scalability, availability, and modifiability, services should not depend on a central coordinator and manage their own state independently.

decisions.name: Publish user events by User Service
decisions.rationale: To enable Notification Service to react to user events without direct dependencies.

decisions.name: Publish order events by Order Service
decisions.rationale: To enable Notification Service and Reporting Service to react to order events without direct dependencies.

decisions.name: Publish payment events by Payment Service
decisions.rationale: To enable Reporting Service to react to payment events without direct dependencies.

decisions.name: Subscribe to user and order events by Notification Service
decisions.rationale: To enable Notification Service to react to user and order events without direct dependencies.

decisions.name: Subscribe to order and payment events by Reporting Service
decisions.rationale: To enable Reporting Service to react to order and payment events without direct dependencies.

decisions.name: Avoid synchronous requests between services
decisions.rationale: To ensure scalability, availability, and modifiability.

decisions.name: Each service manages its own state independently
decisions.rationale: To ensure scalability, availability, and modifiability.

decisions.name: Services react to events without direct dependencies
decisions.rationale: To ensure scalability, availability, and modifiability.

components.name: User Service
components.responsibility: Manages user data and publishes user events

components.name: Order Service
components.responsibility: Manages order data and publishes order events

components.name: Payment Service
components.responsibility: Manages payment data and publishes payment events

components.name: Notification Service
components.responsibility: Subscribes to user and order events to send notifications

components.name: Reporting Service
components.responsibility: Subscribes to order and payment events to generate reports

critique.description: The system's eventual consistency model may impact reliability and consistency.
The relationships between services may impact availability and modifiability.
